root_cause: Style.clear_meta_and_links() builds a copy with _link and _meta set to None but copies the parent's cached _hash (style._hash = self._hash). Style.__hash__ includes _link and _meta, so the cached hash of the cleared style is stale and wrong.
best_solution: In Style.clear_meta_and_links, replace `style._hash = self._hash` with `style._hash = None` so the hash is recomputed lazily from the new (link-free, meta-free) attributes. The statement 'clear hashed cache when clearing meta' points at the method named clear_meta_and_links and at the _hash cache attribute; reading __hash__ shows it depends on _link/_meta, so any copy that changes those must invalidate the cache.
hidden_test_demands: tests/test_style.py::test_clear_meta_and_links_clears_hash: parse 'bold red on black link https://example.org' + Style.on(click='CLICK'), call hash() to populate _hash, assert style._hash is not None, then assert style.clear_meta_and_links()._hash is None (checks the private attribute is exactly None, not merely a correct recomputed hash).
locating_signals: Title 'Clear hashed cache when clearing meta' maps to Style.clear_meta_and_links and the _hash attribute in rich/style.py; the function is effectively named by the statement ('clearing meta'). grep for 'clear_meta' finds a single method.
our_outcome_summary: Solved by all four configs (v4, v6, v7, v8 pass in the Kaggle env); every agent patch is byte-identical to gold (style._hash = None). Pod runs 33-69 s, 14-39 tool calls; v8 used the most calls (39) for the same one-line fix.
generalizable_lesson: When a statement says 'clear/reset the cache when X changes', find every copy/derive method that modifies the fields the cached value depends on and set the cache attribute to its sentinel (None) rather than copying it or recomputing eagerly; tests often assert the private cache attribute is exactly the sentinel.
acceptable_alternatives: Setting _hash = None is required by the test (it checks the attribute is None); eagerly recomputing the hash after clearing would give a correct hash but fail the hidden test's `_hash is None` assertion.
